plan.purpose: Read-only cached Earth vertical-profile diagnostic; no integration, fitting, rain reference or adoption.
plan.anchor: Observed925hPa air temperature, not a below-ground extrapolated surface; predictor receives no higher-level temperatures or observed humidity.
plan.footprints: Reuse hash-verified native ocean masks/areas from circulation_audit_20261026. Footprints are at least80% inmap-covered, at most20% land, and925hPa above maximum model terrain all months. Count native cells, not fine-grid replicas.
plan.comparison: Compare model saturation temperatures and q_sat on exactly matched native pressure levels925–300hPa. Integrate observed and predicted specific humidity by identical trapezoidal quadrature in pressure; ratio of700–300 vs925–700 layer-mean q is partial-column only and not directly comparable to a full-column two-layer ratio. Apply the six already-predeclared pilot profile/humidity combinations; do not tune using these outcomes. Same Gregorian month/day and native-area weights.
plan.publication: Show fixed center humidity.60 examples, retain all6 profiles and all native cells in data. NCEP1981–2010 is model-assisted and differs from WorldClim1970–2000. Tiny ocean samples; diagnostic profiles anchored by observed temperature are not full climate predictions or independent rainfall validation. Does not select or adopt a fit.
